issues: Only the 2025-26 Program of Studies is posted; no 2026-27 edition found on the guidance site (whose pages carry an 'updated: 11.13.26' footer) or via search. The doc is short (28 pp) and still says some courses are 'Offered 2026-27 school year', so it may be what GMUHS is using this year - confirm with the school. Graduation requirements are inside the doc (22.5 credits; Class of 2027 onward 23.5 credits incl. 5 electives; '92 enduring graduation proficiencies'). Catalog covers HS (9-12); school is 7-12 - middle school has a separate site. Live Google Doc; PDF export taken 2026-11-14.
